materials.text: ``` # 内容领域 1： AI 基础知识和素养 **Topics** + [任务 1.1： 描述核心 AI 概念并定义术语。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain1-task1) + [任务 1.2： 确定并选择适当的 AI 解决方案类型。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain1-task2) + [任务 1.3： 应用生成式人工智能概念和技术。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain1-task3) ## 任务 1.1： 描述核心 AI 概念并定义术语。 + 技能 1.1.1： 认识和解释业务环境中的基础 AI 概念（例如，算法、模型、训练、推理、预测）。 + 技能 1.1.2： 区分 AI、机器学习 (ML) 和生成式人工智能 (GenAI)。 + 技能 1.1.3： 区分结构化数据和非结构化数据，并解释 AI 的数据类型相关性。 + 技能 1.1.4： 描述为什么数据质量对 AI 的输出结果有很大的影响。 + 技能 1.1.5： 解释与使用历史数据训练 AI 模型相关的概念。 + 技能 1.1.6： 确保了解全球框架和统一的 AI 词汇表（例如，ISO/IEC 23053、ISO/IEC 42001）。 ## 任务 1.2： 确定并选择适当的 AI 解决方案类型。 + 技能 1.2.1： 确定何时使用基于规则的自动化以及何时使用 AI 解决方案。 + 技能 1.2.2： 将 AI 代理与其他 AI 解决方案区分开来，确定 AI 代理的核心功能（例如，自主性、工具使用、代理间通信和编排策略）。 + 技能 1.2.3： 描述为什么需要持续监控和更新 AI 解决方案，以便检测和修复模型漂移和性能变化。 + 技能 1.2.4： 建立透明的 AI 工具分类体系（例如，已批准、已阻止、正在评估），减少影子 AI 风险。 ## 任务 1.3： 应用生成式人工智能概念和技术。 + 技能 1.3.1： 应用基本的提示工程原理来实现所需的 AI 输出。 + 技能 1.3.2： 确定词元限制或上下文窗口限制何时影响生成式人工智能系统性能。 + 技能 1.3.3： 认识模型自适应技术（例如，检索增强生成 [RAG]、微调）如何改善 AI 对特定业务需求的响应。 ``` ``` # 内容领域 2： AI 战略和商业价值创造 **Topics** + [任务 2.1： 制定符合业务目标的 AI 战略。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain2-task1) + [任务 2.2： 衡量和演示 AI 商业价值。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain2-task2) + [任务 2.3： 确立 AI 所能带来的竞争优势。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain2-task3) ## 任务 2.1： 制定符合业务目标的 AI 战略。 + 技能 2.1.1： 确定跨业务职能（例如，客户运营、销售和营销、研发、软件开发）的高影响力 AI 使用案例，并将 AI 功能与特定业务成果对应起来。 + 技能 2.1.2： 评估 AI 实施的自建、购买或合作开发决策（考虑的因素包括预算、时间表、能力、供应商提议和监管合规要求）。 + 技能 2.1.3： 根据商业价值、可行性、可持续性和战略契合度，来确定 AI 计划的优先级（决定是扩展、暂停还是终止计划）。 + 技能 2.1.4： 确定在什么情况下 AI 并非解决业务问题的合适解决方案。 + 技能 2.1.5： 针对准备将业务流程转向基于 AI 的解决方案或在不同 AI 平台之间进行迁移的情况，评估关键注意事项（例如，业务连续性、成本影响、数据准备情况、性能影响）。 ## 任务 2.2： 衡量和演示 AI 商业价值。 + 技能 2.2.1： 为 AI 计划定义关键绩效指标 (KPI)，包括有形收益（例如，降低成本、增加收入）和无形收益（例如，客户满意度、员工生产力）。 + 技能 2.2.2： 在实施 AI 解决方案之前先建立基准指标，以便准确衡量采用 AI 带来的成果。 + 技能 2.2.3： 通过使用全面的框架来计算 AI 的投资回报 (ROI)（例如节省时间、降低成本、增加收入、提升生产力）。 + 技能 2.2.4： 确定用于预测 AI 项目成功与否的先导性指标。 + 技能 2.2.5： 为 AI 实施建立基本的成本因素控制措施，包括成本规划和优化策略。 ## 任务 2.3： 确立 AI 所能带来的竞争优势。 + 技能 2.3.1： 评估竞争格局并确定采用 AI 的优势。 + 技能 2.3.2： 确定使用 AI 解决方案实现业务模式转型的机会。 + 技能 2.3.3： 描述 AI 如何推动实现可持续的竞争优势和运营改进。 + 技能 2.3.4： 根据行业成熟度和竞争动态，确定合适的 AI 投资水平。 ``` ``` # 内容领域 3： AI 监管与负责任的 AI 领导力 **Topics** + [任务 3.1： 在制订业务决策时应用负责任的 AI 原则。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain3-task1) + [任务 3.2： 建立 AI 监管结构并确保监管合规。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain3-task2) + [任务 3.3： 确定企业人工智能风险以及制定缓解策略。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain3-task3) ## 任务 3.1： 在制订业务决策时应用负责任的 AI 原则。 + 技能 3.1.1： 在业务场景中应用负责任的 AI 原则和维度（例如，公平性、可说明性、隐私、安全、透明度、稳健性）。 + 技能 3.1.2： 当业务目标与负责任的 AI 原则冲突时，进行权衡取舍。 + 技能 3.1.3： 确定在 AI 项目规划中应何时融入负责任的 AI 实践，确保在设计时便纳入了监管措施。 + 技能 3.1.4： 识别 AI 系统需要人工监督的情况，并确定适当的保障措施（例如，幻觉检测、防护机制、进行上报的标准）。 ## 任务 3.2： 建立 AI 监管结构并确保监管合规。 + 技能 3.2.1： 建立具有合理跨职能部门代表性和明确问责机制的 AI 监管结构。 + 技能 3.2.2： 确定并解决使用 AI 的业务流程的监管合规风险。 + 技能 3.2.3： 针对 AI 系统，确定合适的访问控制和数据安全措施。 + 技能 3.2.4： 应用 AI 风险分类框架，确立 AI 生命周期中监管和合规性决策的优先顺序。 ## 任务 3.3： 确定企业人工智能风险以及制定缓解策略。 + 技能 3.3.1： 确定生产环境中 AI 系统的风险控制和监控机制需求。 + 技能 3.3.2： 了解在 AI 生命周期的多个阶段中可能会出现偏差，并说明持续监控偏差偏移的重要性。 + 技能 3.3.3： 管理 AI 系统的有害内容风险和知识产权 (IP) 问题。 + 技能 3.3.4： 确定并减轻与 AI 系统可靠性相关的风险（例如，幻觉、数据质量下降、模型漂移）。 ``` ``` # 内容领域 4： 业务准备情况、领导力和 AI 转型 **Topics** + [任务 4.1： 评估 AI 业务的准备情况和成熟度。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain4-task1) + [任务 4.2： 为 AI 建立数据基础和基础设施基础。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain4-task2) + [任务 4.3： 领导企业范围的变革，打造具备 AI 能力的员工队伍。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain4-task3) + [任务 4.4： 将 AI 从试点项目扩展到全企业部署。](#ai-business-strategist-01-domain4-task4) ## 任务 4.1： 评估 AI 业务的准备情况和成熟度。 + 技能 4.1.1： 根据各关键维度（例如，领导层共识、数据质量、文化适应性、技术基础设施、监管框架），评估企业在采用 AI 方面的准备情况。 + 技能 4.1.2： 运用 AI 成熟度模型，评估企业在 AI 旅程中所处的阶段（例如实验阶段、企业规模部署阶段）。 + 技能 4.1.3： 确定在人员、流程、技术和监管等方面阻碍 AI 成功转型的具体能力差距。 + 技能 4.1.4： 确定开发投资的优先顺序，并根据战略目标和当前业务成熟度水平制定发展路线。 ## 任务 4.2： 为 AI 建立数据基础和基础设施基础。 + 技能 4.2.1： 评估数据准备情况（包括数据质量、可访问性），以及数据孤岛对 AI 计划的影响。 + 技能 4.2.2： 描述为 AI 奠定基础的数据策略、数据所有权和数据共享框架的重要性。 + 技能 4.2.3： 评估支持 AI 计划的基础技术和基础设施要求。 ## 任务 4.3： 领导企业范围的变革，打造具备 AI 能力的员工队伍。 + 技能 4.3.1： 建立高管层支持和领导层共识，识别并赋能 AI 倡导者，在整个企业中保持发展动力。 + 技能 4.3.2： 组建涵盖不同专业领域（例如业务负责人、技术专家、法律、合规性等）的跨职能团队，并为 AI 计划制定明确的责任标准。 + 技能 4.3.3： 制定透明的沟通策略，解决员工对 AI 的担忧（例如，实施时间表、预期结果、对员工角色的影响）。 + 技能 4.3.4： 认识 AI 采用中的文化障碍（例如，规避风险、抗拒改变、害怕失败），并确定领导层用来应对这些问题的干预措施。 + 技能 4.3.5： 确定合适的员工培养方法，来加速提升整个企业的 AI 素养（例如，概念验证 [POC] 计划、黑客马拉松、培训计划、负责任的 AI 培训）。 + 技能 4.3.6： 发现各种机会来转变人员的角色，从人工操作转向人工监督并与 AI 系统进行协作，以及制定战略决策，在人工优势（例如批判性思维、同理心、创造力）与 AI 功能之间取得平衡。 ## 任务 4.4： 将 AI 从试点项目扩展到全企业部署。 + 技能 4.4.1： 采用分阶段进行的迭代式转型方法（例如，构想、实验、启动、扩展）。 + 技能 4.4.2： 实施扩展方法，从短期成果开始，再逐步扩大到全企业部署。 + 技能 4.4.3： 建立 AI 卓越中心 (COE) 和跨职能协作机制来支持扩展。 + 技能 4.4.4： 建立持续的反馈机制和成功指标，用于跟踪 AI 计划的进展和长期价值。 + 技能 4.4.5： 处理 AI 计划从实验阶段转向生产阶段的过渡，包括监管和运营要求。 + 技能 4.4.6： 评估整个 AI 扩展计划在全企业推广中的多方面因素，确保业务连续性和性能。 ``` ``` # 考试中可能出现的技术和概念 下表包含考试中可能出现的技术和概念。本列表并未列出所有内容，并且可能随时会更改。表中各项的顺序与位置，并不代表考试中的相对权重或重要性： + AI、机器学习 (ML) 和生成式人工智能 (GenAI) 之间的主要区别 + 如何训练 AI 模型、进行预测以及随时间推移进行改进 + 数据类型（例如，结构化、非结构化）以及为什么数据质量对 AI 的输出结果有很大的影响 + 提示工程基础知识以及如何获得有用的 AI 输出 + 上下文窗口和词元如何影响生成式人工智能的性能 + 用于改进 AI 响应的技术（例如，检索增强生成 [RAG]、微调） + 什么是 AI 代理及其与其他 AI 工具的不同之处 + 何时使用基于规则的自动化而不是 AI + 为什么 AI 系统需要持续监控（例如，模型漂移、性能变动） + 未经批准使用 AI 工具（影子 AI）的风险以及如何管理风险 + 使用关键绩效指标 (KPI)、投资回报 (ROI)、成本节省和生产力提升来衡量 AI 价值 + AI 解决方案的自建、购买或合作开发决策 + 按业务影响和可行性来确定 AI 计划优先级 + 负责任的 AI 原则（例如，公平性、可说明性、隐私、安全、透明度） + 监管结构以及 AI 决策的负责人 + AI 系统的风险分类 + AI 的监管和合规性注意事项 + 人工监督、防护机制以及了解何时上报 + 常见的 AI 可靠性问题（例如，幻觉、偏差、数据质量下降） + 使用 AI 时的知识产权 (IP) 注意事项 + 评估企业的 AI 准备情况和成熟度 + 数据策略、数据所有权和打破数据孤岛 + 领导 AI 的变革管理和员工转型 + 提升整个企业的 AI 素养 + 将 AI 从试点项目扩展到全企业采用 + AI 卓越中心 (COE) + Amazon Bedrock、Amazon SageMaker AI 和 Amazon Quick（战略层面） + AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) + AI 工作负载的 AWS 责任共担模式 + AWS 人工智能定价和成本优化策略 + 全球 AI 标准和框架（例如，ISO/IEC 23053、ISO/IEC 42001） ```

# AWS Certified AI Business Strategist: Collected Study Materials

**Exam:** AIB-C01  
**Language:** English  
**Research date:** October 20, 2026  
**Target exam date:** November 13, 2026

This collection brings together the official learning pathway, exam guide, practice resources, targeted courses, and supporting reading. It includes study notes for offline review. It is not a copy of every course, video, or question bank.

## Contents

1. Exam orientation
2. The two official learning pathways
3. Existing official question and practice resources
4. Targeted course directory
5. Coverage map for all 13 official tasks
6. Public reading collection
7. Offline revision notes
8. Flexible study method
9. Access limitations and collection checklist

## 1. Exam orientation

The certification assesses business decisions about AI investment, value, governance, and adoption. It does not require coding or hands-on AWS implementation experience.

The current beta overview lists 85 questions, 170 minutes, and a USD 50 beta fee. Question types are multiple choice and multiple response. English and Japanese are listed. The standard price is USD 100 before applicable adjustments.

The general guide lists 130 minutes, so use your actual appointment confirmation for the applicable version and duration. Its passing score is scaled to 700 out of 1,000, not a direct raw-percentage threshold.

**Official sources**

- [Certification overview](https://aws.amazon.com/certification/certified-ai-business-strategist/)
- [English exam guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/ai-business-strategist-01/ai-business-strategist-01.html)
- [Launch announcement, September 1, 2026](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/training-and-certification/introducing-aws-certified-ai-business-strategist-built-for-the-people-who-scale-ai/)
- [Before Testing: beta policies and ESL accommodation](https://aws.amazon.com/certification/policies/before-testing/)

The landing page says AWS services knowledge is not assessed, while the guide mentions high-level awareness. Treat services as business context and prioritize the decision skills.

## 2. The two official learning pathways

These serve different purposes. The role pathway teaches the subject; the preparation pathway focuses on the assessment.

### A. Learn the subject

**[AWS AI Business Strategist Learning Plan](https://skillbuilder.aws/learning-plan/TSP9R1XQ6P/aws-ai-business-strategist-learning-plan/BDE88AHVZN)**

- Provider: AWS Skill Builder.
- Catalog duration: 14 hours 30 minutes.
- AWS's announcement describes 13 modules aligned to the four domains.
- Start here if you want to understand the material before practicing exam questions.
- Access: requires a functioning JavaScript browser; enrollment and item-specific access should be checked after sign-in. The complete lesson content was not available to this research session.

The listed duration is content time, not a guarantee of total preparation time. Notes, review, and question practice take additional time.

### B. Prepare for the exam

**[Exam Prep Plan: AWS Certified AI Business Strategist (AIB-C01 - English)](https://skillbuilder.aws/learning-plan/B8J6KKJ45C/exam-prep-plan--aws-certified-ai-business-strategist-aibc01--english/KQ8WMK8CTE)**

**[Alternative official exam-prep landing page](https://skillbuilder.aws/category/exam-prep/ai-business-strategist-business-AIB-C01)**

- Provider: AWS Skill Builder.
- Use it for examination orientation, targeted review, and the practice sequence.
- AWS recommends it as the starting point for experienced candidates.
- The catalog is dynamic and some components require a subscription.
- The official certification page says the full Official Practice Exam is unavailable during beta. Do not confuse it with the shorter free Practice Question Set.

**Suggested order:** role learning plan → official question set → weak-topic review → domain practice and simulator where available.

## 3. Existing official question and practice resources

This section lists existing published AWS resources. No invented question count is presented as an official bank, and no AI-written questions have been inserted in place of unavailable official items.

### P01. Official Practice Question Set

**[Open the official question set](https://skillbuilder.aws/learn/NN5MQE4G3M/official-practice-question-set-aws-certified-ai-business-strategist-aibc01--english/9TUSJ7NJ7N)**

| Detail | Verified catalog information |
|---|---|
| Questions | 20 |
| Listed duration | 30 minutes |
| Access | Free; sign-up/sign-in to enroll |
| Answers | Detailed feedback for answer choices and further learning resources |
| Repeated attempts | Same questions in a different order |
| Exam alignment | AIB-C01 |

This is the strongest first source for official question style. The 20 items are not the entire syllabus or a new random test on each attempt. Question text and explanations are inside the course and were not retrieved during this research; this document links to them rather than falsely presenting a copied bank.

**How to use:** make a first attempt, record missed concepts and guessed answers, read the explanations, and revisit the mapped learning topic. A higher score on the same 20 questions mainly measures familiarity with those questions.

### P02. Domain 1 Review

**[Domain 1 Review](https://skillbuilder.aws/learn/MJJV59JGPH/domain-1-review-aws-certified-ai-business-strategist-aibc01--english/HYDBE95DFH)**

An official review resource for AI Fundamentals and Literacy. Use before or after Domain 1 practice. A direct listing was found; access tier, complete contents, and duration were not independently confirmed.

### P03. Domain 1 Practice

**[Domain 1 Practice](https://skillbuilder.aws/learn/J7UZME2KDK/domain-1-practice-aws-certified-ai-business-strategist-aibc01--english/QJP6PUNERC)**

An official exam-preparation practice resource. The indexed description identifies Domain 1 coverage. Question count, full answer content, duration, and account access were not confirmed.

### P04. Domain 2 Review

**[Domain 2 Review](https://skillbuilder.aws/learn/2AAQCJ56ZH/domain-2-review-aws-certified-ai-business-strategist-aibc01--english/HSFKCZ9Z9Z)**

An official review resource for AI Strategy and Business Value Creation. The direct listing was located; use the signed-in catalog for current access conditions.

### P05. Domain 2 Practice: Meeting Simulator

**[Meeting Simulator: AI Business Strategist](https://skillbuilder.aws/learn/HMJ98XZZES/domain-2-practice-meeting-simulator-ai-business-strategist-aibc01--english/D4WZ5R5X4T)**

- Catalog duration: 30 minutes.
- Indexed catalog material identifies subscription access.
- Intended use: practicing strategic judgment in a simulated meeting.
- Do not treat it as a full-length multiple-choice examination.

### P06. Domain 3 Practice

**[Domain 3 Practice](https://skillbuilder.aws/learn/7GP9XX1ENR/domain-3-practice-aws-certified-ai-business-strategist-aibc01--english/1VDY7SXBKX)**

- Catalog duration: one hour.
- Access listed: subscription needed.
- Includes exam-style practice and flashcards for governance and responsible AI.
- Question count and complete answers were not publicly retrieved.

### P07. Domain 4 Practice

**[Official catalog result for AIB-C01](https://skillbuilder.aws/search?searchText=aib-c01&utm_medium=blog&utm_source=vocecertificado)**

An indexed official result explicitly lists “Domain 4 Practice: AWS Certified AI Business Strategist (AIB-C01 - English).” Its standalone course URL and access tier were not resolved. Open the exam prep plan or search that exact title in Skill Builder. This is a catalog entry point, not a verified standalone course link.

### P08. Walk-through questions

AWS's launch announcement names Walk-through Questions as part of preparation. Access them through the [Exam Prep Plan](https://skillbuilder.aws/learning-plan/B8J6KKJ45C/exam-prep-plan--aws-certified-ai-business-strategist-aibc01--english/KQ8WMK8CTE). An independent direct URL, item count, and complete content were not verified.

### P09. Full Official Practice Exam

The [certification overview](https://aws.amazon.com/certification/certified-ai-business-strategist/) currently states that this is not available during beta. No full official mock exam is included here.

## 4. Targeted course directory

These are existing course titles found in official listings. Durations and access are reported only where established. If a direct page displays a JavaScript message, use a normal browser and open it from the learning plan.

| ID | Existing course | Link | Status |

## 6. Public reading collection

These materials can usually be read without course enrollment. They supplement the syllabus rather than replacing it. Read the indicated parts, not necessarily every page. Descriptions are concise summaries; the learning actions are study recommendations.

### R01. What is Artificial Intelligence?

[AWS explanation](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/artificial-intelligence/)

**Focus:** distinctions among AI, ML, and deep learning; applications and business outcomes.  
**Use:** build a vocabulary foundation. You do not need to memorize the history timeline for this preparation route.

### R02. What is Generative AI?

[AWS explanation](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/generative-ai/)

**Focus:** content generation, foundation models, use cases, and limitations.  
**Use:** distinguish creating a summary from forecasting a numerical outcome; identify quality requirements for generated content.

### R03. What are AI Agents?

[AWS explanation](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/ai-agents/)

**Focus:** goal-directed behavior, tool use, and agent workflows.  
**Use:** describe what additional action authority means for permissions, oversight, and business risk. Skip implementation details unless they clarify a concept.

### R04. What is RAG?

[AWS explanation](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/retrieval-augmented-generation/)

**Focus:** connecting a generative model with relevant external information.  
**Use:** understand why retrieval can help with organization-specific or updated knowledge. Check source quality, freshness, and authorization; retrieval is not a correctness guarantee.

### R05. What is Prompt Engineering?

[AWS explanation](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is/prompt-engineering/)

**Focus:** instructions, context, examples, and desired output.  
**Use:** identify whether poor output is caused by unclear instructions, missing information, or a deeper limitation. Prompt changes do not replace security enforcement or evaluation.

### R06. The Path-to-Value Framework

[AWS article](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/navigating-the-generative-ai-journey-the-path-to-value-framework-from-aws/)

**Focus:** connecting AI activity with measurable outcomes and a path toward delivery.  
**Use:** read for business sequencing and the conditions needed to progress beyond experimentation. Treat this as supporting strategy material, not a separate required certification.

### R07. Getting ROI from Generative AI

[AWS Executive Insights episode and article](https://aws.amazon.com/executive-insights/podcast/getting-roi-from-generative-ai-databricks/)

**Focus:** business impact, implementation, and iterative improvement.  
**Use:** connect revenue, efficiency, and customer outcomes to measurements; separate a claimed benefit from one that has actually been realized.

### R08. Generative AI Is the Answer: What Was the Question?

[AWS Executive Insights discussion and transcript](https://aws.amazon.com/executive-insights/content/generative-ai-is-the-answer-what-was-the-question/)

**Focus:** business objectives, data strategy, and transformation.  
**Use:** read the transcript in short sections. After each, note the business problem, organizational requirement, and decision being discussed.

### R09. AWS Responsible AI

[Official responsible AI hub](https://aws.amazon.com/ai/responsible-ai/)

**Focus:** responsible AI dimensions and the AWS approach.  
**Use:** distinguish fairness, privacy, explainability, transparency, and safety rather than treating them as synonyms. Follow only the relevant linked material.

### R10. Responsible AI: From Principles to Production

[AWS article, June 24, 2025](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/enterprise-strategy/responsible-ai-from-principles-to-production/)

**Focus:** governance and culture, repeatable processes, and technical safeguards.  
**Use:** connect a risk to a control, an owner, and a monitoring process. The useful learning point is how principles become operating practices; commercial claims and statistics are not memorization targets.

### R11. Shared Responsibility Model

[AWS official explanation](https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/shared-responsibility-model/)

**Focus:** how provider and customer responsibilities differ with the services selected.  
**Use:** understand that using a managed service does not remove customer responsibility for data and appropriate use. Skip infrastructure administration detail.

### R12. AWS Cloud Adoption Framework

[Official overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-aws-cloud-adoption-framework/welcome.html)

**Focus:** business, people, governance, platform, security, and operations perspectives.  
**Use:** identify missing organizational capabilities and connect investments to readiness. The framework is useful for structuring assessment rather than merely memorizing labels.

### R13. NIST AI Risk Management Framework

[NIST official framework hub](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework)

**Focus:** the voluntary AI risk-management framework and linked official resources.  
**Use:** supporting reading for risk identification and lifecycle management. This is supplemental, not a claim that every NIST detail is an AIB-C01 requirement.

### R14. ISO/IEC 42001

[ISO official overview](https://www.iso.org/standard/42001)

**Focus:** an AI management system standard.  
**Use:** recognize its organizational management purpose and distinguish awareness from certification implementation expertise. The public overview is readable; the full standard is a separate purchase. Buying the standard is not necessary for this collection.

### R15. Building an Enterprise-Ready Generative AI Platform

[AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/strategy-enterprise-ready-gen-ai-platform/)

**Focus:** moving prototypes toward enterprise use with governance and reusable capabilities.  
**Use:** read the intended audience, objectives, and strategic sections. Skip architecture and configuration detail beyond your needs.

### R16. AWS Pricing Calculator

[Official overview](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/aws-pricing-calculator/)

**Focus:** estimating prospective service costs.  
**Use:** distinguish a planning estimate from an actual bill and understand why workload assumptions affect cost projections. No cloud deployment is required.

### R17. AWS Cost Explorer

[Official overview](https://aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/aws-cost-explorer/)

**Focus:** analyzing cost and usage.  
**Use:** distinguish cost estimation before adoption from examination of ongoing spending patterns.

## 7. Offline revision notes

These are independent learning explanations, not extracts from private AWS lessons or official question answers. They are included so you can read something useful without opening every link.

### 7.1 Compare capabilities

| Capability | Typical purpose | Business evaluation |
|---|---|---|
| Deterministic rules | Execute explicit conditions consistently | Correctness against the policy and handling of exceptions |
| Predictive ML | Estimate outcomes from patterns | Relevant errors, value of predictions, and changing conditions |
| Generative AI | Produce drafts, summaries, or other content | Factuality, usefulness, review effort, and appropriate usage |
| Agent workflow | Coordinate actions and tools toward a goal | Task success, authorized actions, reversibility, and oversight |

The same system can combine several capabilities. A document workflow might use extraction to identify fields, deterministic logic to enforce a threshold, and generation to explain the result. Evaluate each part rather than assigning one fashionable label to the whole process.

### 7.2 Compare adaptation methods

| Method | Primary change | Typical consideration |
|---|---|---|
| Prompt improvement | Instructions and supplied context | Cheap to experiment with, but bounded by available context and model ability |
| Retrieval | Information available to the response | Source freshness, retrieval quality, permissions, and evidence |
| Fine-tuning | Model behavior through further training | Appropriate examples, maintenance, evaluation, and whether it addresses the actual gap |

These approaches are not mutually exclusive. Changing instructions cannot ensure that absent facts become available. Adding a knowledge source cannot ensure that the right source is retrieved or interpreted correctly.

### 7.3 Build a credible value case

Define the current workflow and its measured problems. Specify whose work changes and what the desired outcome is. Compare realistic alternatives and include the cost of adoption.

Useful distinctions:

- **Baseline:** the measured starting condition.
- **Target:** the intended improvement.
- **Leading signal:** early evidence that may predict the result.
- **Realized outcome:** the result that has actually occurred.
- **Capacity released:** time available for other work.
- **Cash saved:** expenditure genuinely reduced or avoided.

Avoid counting a time saving twice, once as reduced labor cost and again as additional output, unless the assumptions demonstrate that both benefits are distinct and achievable.

### 7.4 Understand simple financial reasoning

For a defined period:

**ROI = (benefits − costs) / costs**

Illustrative example: annual benefits of USD 90,000 and annual costs of USD 60,000 give a simple ROI of 50%. This is arithmetic for learning, not an AWS question.

State whether setup costs, ongoing usage, review, training, maintenance, and ramp-up are included. Test a downside case with lower adoption or higher review effort. Attractive optimistic arithmetic is weak evidence without credible assumptions.

### 7.5 Match safeguards to the failure

| Concern | Relevant response to evaluate |
|---|---|
| Unsupported claims | Evidence checks, appropriate retrieval, evaluation, and review |
| Unauthorized data exposure | Enforced access controls and incident handling |
| Unequal performance | Relevant subgroup assessment and remediation |
| Unapproved tool use | Clear permitted tools, training, and a review process |
| Excessive agent authority | Scoped permissions, approval requirements, logging, and intervention |
| Declining performance | Monitoring thresholds, investigation, and correction |

No single control resolves all risks. A confidentiality instruction is not permission enforcement. A human reviewer needs enough information, time, and authority to be effective.

### 7.6 Assess readiness before expansion

Readiness concerns the organization around the model. Consider ownership, leadership support, staff capability, data availability, workflow changes, support, and risk management.

A pilot may succeed because it uses clean data and enthusiastic volunteers. Wider deployment may expose inconsistent data, unfamiliar users, cost growth, or support gaps. Expansion should test whether the pilot's assumptions transfer.

Define what justifies scaling, what requires remediation, and what would stop the initiative. Keep a fallback for important operations.

### 7.7 Read scenario questions carefully

Identify the goal, the current stage, the key constraint, and the action requested. “First” concerns sequencing; “best” concerns the fit among alternatives. Evaluate each required choice in multiple-response questions.

Do not turn examples into universal rules such as always preferring a pilot, always preferring governance, or always choosing the lowest price. A good answer addresses the situation described.

## 8. Flexible study method

This collection does not require a fixed daily timetable.

| Available time | Useful action |
|---|---|
| 5 minutes | Read one revision subsection or one part of an official article. |
| 15 minutes | Continue a course segment and write a short English explanation. |
| 30 minutes | Work through targeted official practice and review its answer feedback. |
| A longer block | Combine domain review with new practice, or assess exam pacing. |

**Minimum route through the collection**

1. Read the orientation and official guide.
2. Open the role learning plan if you need foundations.
3. Attempt P01 and record gaps.
4. Use the task map to choose courses and readings.
5. Use domain practice and simulation if your access permits.
6. Recheck every official skill statement before deciding you are ready.

Do not buy several overlapping resources immediately. The confirmed free question set and public readings allow a useful start. Check the current included catalog before paying for a subscription.

## 9. Access limitations and collection checklist

### What is included

- Both official pathways and the official exam guide.
- Existing practice and review resources with direct links where located.
- A directory of 11 located course titles, with uncertainty labeled.
- A map of all 13 official tasks and 58 skill codes.
- Seventeen supporting reading entries.
- Offline explanations, comparisons, and study guidance.

### What remains at its original source

- The actual 20 official practice questions and their detailed explanations.
- Private course lesson bodies, videos, flashcards, and subscription practice.
- The complete dynamic pathway outline behind the JavaScript interface.
- The full ISO standard, which is separately licensed.

The document is a researched collection and study companion, not a complete offline mirror of all AWS training. Public catalog visibility does not mean course contents were downloaded or that every item is free.
